001package dev.nandi0813.api;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.DivisionName;
004import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.LeaderboardType;
005import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.PlayerState;
006import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.WeightClass;
007import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.CosmeticsRegistry;
008import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.FFA;
009import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.HotbarItemRegistry;
010import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Match;
011import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.NameDecorationRegistry;
012import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Party;
013import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Queue;
014import dev.nandi0813.api.Utilities.PlayerNametag;
015import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
016import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
017
018import java.util.List;
019
020public abstract class ZonePracticeApi
021{
022
023    /**
024     * Incremented on every additive API release. 2.4.0 = 3, 2.5.0 = 4, 2.6.0 = 5, 2.7.0 = 6.
025     */
026    public static final int API_VERSION = 6;
027
028    /**
029     * Use {@link #getInstance()}. Kept for binary compatibility; set by the core plugin only.
030     */
031    @Deprecated
032    public static ZonePracticeApi instance = null;
033
034    public static ZonePracticeApi getInstance() {
035        return instance;
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * Check whether ZonePractice Pro has registered its API implementation.
040     * @return true if {@link #getInstance()} returns a non-null instance
041     */
042    public static boolean isAvailable() {
043        return instance != null;
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Get the player's division. Main thread only.
048     * @param player The player
049     * @param divisionName Short or Full name of the division
050     * @return The player's division, or null if the player has no loaded profile
051     */
052    public abstract String getPlayerDivision(Player player, DivisionName divisionName);
053
054    /**
055     * Get the amount of unranked matches left for the player. Main thread only.
056     * @param player The player
057     * @return The amount of unranked matches left, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
058     */
059    public abstract int getPlayerUnRankedLeft(Player player);
060
061    /**
062     * Get the amount of ranked matches left for the player. Main thread only.
063     * @param player The player
064     * @return The amount of ranked matches left, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
065     */
066    public abstract int getPlayerRankedLeft(Player player);
067
068    /**
069     * Reset the player's unranked matches. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
070     * Main thread only.
071     * @param player The player
072     */
073    public abstract void resetPlayerUnRanked(Player player);
074
075    /**
076     * Reset the player's ranked matches. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
077     * Main thread only.
078     * @param player The player
079     */
080    public abstract void resetPlayerRanked(Player player);
081
082    /**
083     * Add unranked matches to the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
084     * Main thread only.
085     * @param player The player
086     * @param amount The amount of unranked matches to add
087     */
088    public abstract void addPlayerUnRanked(Player player, int amount);
089
090    /**
091     * Add ranked matches to the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
092     * Main thread only.
093     * @param player The player
094     * @param amount The amount of ranked matches to add
095     */
096    public abstract void addPlayerRanked(Player player, int amount);
097
098    /**
099     * End the match for the player. Does nothing if the player is not in a match.
100     * Main thread only.
101     * @param player The player
102     * @param endMessage The message to send to the match, in MiniMessage format. Nullable.
103     */
104    public abstract void endMatch(Player player, String endMessage);
105
106    /**
107     * Get the player's elo for a specific ladder. Main thread only.
108     * @param player The player
109     * @param ladder The ladder
110     * @return The player's elo, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile, the ladder name is unknown,
111     *         or the ladder is unranked-only
112     */
113    public abstract int getElo(Player player, String ladder);
114
115    /**
116     * Get the player's experience points. Main thread only.
117     * @param player The player
118     * @return The player's experience, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
119     */
120    public abstract int getExperience(Player player);
121
122    /**
123     * Get the player's wins for a specific weight class. Main thread only.
124     * @param player The player
125     * @param ladder The ladder
126     * @param weightClass The weight class
127     * @return The player's wins, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
128     */
129    public abstract int getLadderWins(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
130
131    /**
132     * Get the player's losses for a specific weight class. Main thread only.
133     * @param player The player
134     * @param ladder The ladder
135     * @param weightClass The weight class
136     * @return The player's losses, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
137     */
138    public abstract int getLadderLosses(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
139
140    /**
141     * Get the player's global wins. Main thread only.
142     * @param player The player
143     * @return The player's global wins (unranked + ranked), or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
144     */
145    public abstract int getGlobalWins(Player player);
146
147    /**
148     * Retrieves the nametag information of a given player. Main thread only.
149     *
150     * @param player The player whose nametag information is to be retrieved.
151     * @return The {@link PlayerNametag} associated with the specified player, containing
152     *         prefix, name color, and suffix components, or null if the player has no loaded profile.
153     */
154    public abstract PlayerNametag getPlayerNametag(Player player);
155
156    /**
157     * Get the player's current state. Main thread only.
158     * @param player The player
159     * @return The player's state, never null; {@link PlayerState#UNKNOWN} if the player has no loaded profile
160     */
161    public abstract PlayerState getPlayerState(Player player);
162
163    /**
164     * Get the live match the player fights in. Spectated matches are not returned. Main thread only.
165     * @param player The player
166     * @return The match, or null if the player is not fighting in a match
167     */
168    public abstract Match getMatch(Player player);
169
170    /**
171     * Get the match the player is spectating. Main thread only.
172     * @param player The player
173     * @return The spectated match, or null if the player is not spectating a match
174     */
175    public abstract Match getSpectatingMatch(Player player);
176
177    /**
178     * Get a match by its id, including matches that already ended. Main thread only.
179     * @param matchId The match id, see {@link Match#getMatchId()}
180     * @return The match, or null if no match has this id
181     * @since 2.6.0
182     */
183    public abstract Match getMatchById(String matchId);
184
185    /**
186     * Get the FFA the player fights in. Main thread only.
187     * @param player The player
188     * @return The FFA, or null if the player is not fighting in an FFA
189     */
190    public abstract FFA getFfa(Player player);
191
192    /**
193     * Get the event the player is in. Main thread only.
194     * @param player The player
195     * @return The event, or null if the player is not in an event
196     */
197    public abstract dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Event getEvent(Player player);
198
199    /**
200     * Get the party the player is in. Main thread only.
201     * @param player The player
202     * @return The party, or null if the player is not in a party
203     */
204    public abstract Party getParty(Player player);
205
206    /**
207     * Get the queue the player is in. Main thread only.
208     * @param player The player
209     * @return The queue, or null if the player is not queued
210     */
211    public abstract Queue getQueue(Player player);
212
213    /**
214     * Get the names of all enabled ladders. Main thread only.
215     * @return An unmodifiable list of ladder names, never null
216     */
217    public abstract List<String> getLadderNames();
218
219    /**
220     * Get the player's kills on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
221     * @param player The player
222     * @param ladder The ladder name
223     * @return The player's kills, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
224     */
225    public abstract int getLadderKills(Player player, String ladder);
226
227    /**
228     * Get the player's deaths on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
229     * @param player The player
230     * @param ladder The ladder name
231     * @return The player's deaths, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
232     */
233    public abstract int getLadderDeaths(Player player, String ladder);
234
235    /**
236     * Get the registry for addon cosmetics categories.
237     * @return The cosmetics registry, never null
238     */
239    public abstract CosmeticsRegistry getCosmeticsRegistry();
240
241    /**
242     * Get the registry for addon hotbar items.
243     * @return The hotbar item registry, never null
244     */
245    public abstract HotbarItemRegistry getHotbarItemRegistry();
246
247    /**
248     * Open the cosmetics hub for the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
249     * Main thread only.
250     * @param player The player
251     */
252    public abstract void openCosmeticsMenu(Player player);
253
254    /**
255     * Get the registry for name decorators.
256     * @return The name decoration registry, never null
257     */
258    public abstract NameDecorationRegistry getNameDecorationRegistry();
259
260    /**
261     * Get the player's current global win streak. Main thread only.
262     * @param player The player
263     * @return The win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
264     */
265    public abstract int getWinStreak(Player player);
266
267    /**
268     * Get the player's best global win streak. Main thread only.
269     * @param player The player
270     * @return The best win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
271     */
272    public abstract int getBestWinStreak(Player player);
273
274    /**
275     * Get the player's best win streak on a specific ladder and weight class. Main thread only.
276     * @param player The player
277     * @param ladder The ladder name
278     * @param weightClass The weight class
279     * @return The best win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
280     */
281    public abstract int getLadderBestWinStreak(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
282
283    /**
284     * Get the player's current FFA kill streak. Main thread only.
285     * @param player The player
286     * @return The kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
287     */
288    public abstract int getKillStreak(Player player);
289
290    /**
291     * Get the player's best global FFA kill streak. Main thread only.
292     * @param player The player
293     * @return The best kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
294     */
295    public abstract int getBestKillStreak(Player player);
296
297    /**
298     * Get the player's best FFA kill streak on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
299     * @param player The player
300     * @param ladder The ladder name
301     * @return The best kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
302     */
303    public abstract int getLadderBestKillStreak(Player player, String ladder);
304
305    /**
306     * Get the player's kills summed over all ladders. Main thread only.
307     * @param player The player
308     * @return The global kills, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
309     */
310    public abstract int getGlobalKills(Player player);
311
312    /**
313     * Get the player's global matches played (wins + losses). Main thread only.
314     * @param player The player
315     * @return The matches played, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
316     */
317    public abstract int getMatchesPlayed(Player player);
318
319    /**
320     * Get the time the player first joined the server. Main thread only.
321     * @param player The player
322     * @return The first join time in epoch millis, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
323     */
324    public abstract long getFirstJoin(Player player);
325
326    /**
327     * Get the names of all divisions, ordered lowest to highest. Main thread only.
328     * @param divisionName Short or Full name of the divisions
329     * @return An unmodifiable list of division names, never null
330     */
331    public abstract List<String> getDivisionNames(DivisionName divisionName);
332
333    /**
334     * Get the player's position on a leaderboard. Main thread only.
335     * @param player The player
336     * @param type The statistic the leaderboard is ranked by
337     * @param ladder The ladder name, or null for the global leaderboard.
338     * @return The 1-based position, or -1 if the player is not on the leaderboard, the leaderboard does not exist,
339     *         or the ladder name is unknown. Leaderboards hold the top entries only and refresh periodically.
340     */
341    public abstract int getLeaderboardPosition(Player player, LeaderboardType type, String ladder);
342
343    /**
344     * Queue the player for a ladder, like the queue menu does. The player gets the usual queue messages.
345     * Already queued for the ladder: nothing changes. Main thread only.
346     * @param player The player
347     * @param ladder The ladder name
348     * @param ranked true for the ranked queue, false for unranked
349     * @param keepInventoryOpen Keep the player's open inventory open, only applies with multi-queue
350     * @return true if the player is queued for the ladder or a match started right away; false if the player has
351     *         no loaded profile, is not in the lobby or a queue, is in staff mode or a party, the ladder is unknown,
352     *         disabled, frozen or unranked-only for a ranked queue, or a queue requirement failed
353     * @since 2.7.0
354     */
355    public abstract boolean queuePlayer(Player player, String ladder, boolean ranked, boolean keepInventoryOpen);
356
357    /**
358     * Remove a ladder from the player's queue. The queue ends when it was the last ladder.
359     * Does nothing if the player is not queued for the ladder. Main thread only.
360     * @param player The player
361     * @param ladder The ladder name
362     * @since 2.7.0
363     */
364    public abstract void leaveQueue(Player player, String ladder);
365
366    /**
367     * End the player's queue for every ladder. Does nothing if the player is not queued. Main thread only.
368     * @param player The player
369     * @since 2.7.0
370     */
371    public abstract void leaveAllQueues(Player player);
372
373    /**
374     * Check whether the player may queue for several ladders at once. Main thread only.
375     * @param player The player
376     * @return true if multi-queue is enabled in the config and the player has its permission
377     * @since 2.7.0
378     */
379    public abstract boolean isMultiQueueAllowed(Player player);
380
381    /**
382     * Get the names of the ladders the player is queued for. Main thread only.
383     * @param player The player
384     * @return An unmodifiable list of ladder names, empty if the player is not queued, never null
385     * @since 2.7.0
386     */
387    public abstract List<String> getQueuedLadderNames(Player player);
388
389    /**
390     * Check whether the player is queued for a ladder. Main thread only.
391     * @param player The player
392     * @param ladder The ladder name
393     * @return true if the player is queued for the ladder
394     * @since 2.7.0
395     */
396    public abstract boolean isQueued(Player player, String ladder);
397
398    /**
399     * Get the number of players queued for a ladder in one queue type. Main thread only.
400     * @param ladder The ladder name
401     * @param ranked true for the ranked queue, false for unranked
402     * @return The number of queued players, or -1 if the ladder name is unknown
403     * @since 2.7.0
404     */
405    public abstract int getQueuePlayerCount(String ladder, boolean ranked);
406
407    /**
408     * Get the number of players queued for a ladder, ranked and unranked together. Main thread only.
409     * @param ladder The ladder name
410     * @return The number of queued players, or -1 if the ladder name is unknown
411     * @since 2.7.0
412     */
413    public abstract int getQueuePlayerCount(String ladder);
414
415    /**
416     * Get the icon of a ladder. Main thread only.
417     * @param ladder The ladder name
418     * @return A copy of the ladder icon, or null if the ladder name is unknown or the ladder has no icon
419     * @since 2.7.0
420     */
421    public abstract ItemStack getLadderIcon(String ladder);
422
423    /**
424     * Get the display name of a ladder. Main thread only.
425     * @param ladder The ladder name
426     * @return The display name in MiniMessage format, or null if the ladder name is unknown
427     * @since 2.7.0
428     */
429    public abstract String getLadderDisplayName(String ladder);
430
431    /**
432     * Get the player's progress towards the next division, the same value the division menu shows. Main thread only.
433     * @param player The player
434     * @return The progress from 0 to 100, 100 if the player is in the highest division, or -1 if the player has no
435     *         loaded profile or no divisions exist
436     * @since 2.7.0
437     */
438    public abstract double getPlayerDivisionProgress(Player player);
439
440    /**
441     * Get the division after the player's current division. Main thread only.
442     * @param player The player
443     * @param divisionName Short or Full name of the division
444     * @return The next division's name, or null if the player has no loaded profile or is in the highest division
445     * @since 2.7.0
446     */
447    public abstract String getPlayerNextDivision(Player player, DivisionName divisionName);
448
449    /**
450     * Get the global elo a division requires. Main thread only.
451     * @param division The division's key in divisions.yml, or its short or full name as returned by
452     *                 {@link #getDivisionNames(DivisionName)}
453     * @return The required elo, or -1 if the division is unknown
454     * @since 2.7.0
455     */
456    public abstract int getDivisionRequiredElo(String division);
457
458    /**
459     * Get the global experience a division requires. Main thread only.
460     * @param division The division's key in divisions.yml, or its short or full name as returned by
461     *                 {@link #getDivisionNames(DivisionName)}
462     * @return The required experience, or -1 if the division is unknown
463     * @since 2.7.0
464     */
465    public abstract int getDivisionRequiredExperience(String division);
466
467    /**
468     * Get the global wins a division requires. Main thread only.
469     * @param division The division's key in divisions.yml, or its short or full name as returned by
470     *                 {@link #getDivisionNames(DivisionName)}
471     * @return The required wins, or -1 if the division is unknown
472     * @since 2.7.0
473     */
474    public abstract int getDivisionRequiredWins(String division);
475
476}
